real.label: Real
real.explanation: Measured data: terrain, imagery, orbital spectra, radiation series, Navcam photos and rover positions.

modelled.label: Modelled
modelled.explanation: Computed from real data by the planner's model, shown with its range.

simulated.label: Simulated
simulated.explanation: Hypothetical: the crew, the EVA, the storm timing and position drift are scenarios, not observations.

live.label: Live
live.explanation: Computed live on request by the same engine; not part of the validated scorecard.

visual.label: Visual
visual.explanation: Artistic only: sky colour, haze, figures and particles carry no data.

popover.title: Where this number comes from

assumed.label: assumed
assumed.explanation: Assumed value, not measured; see the assumptions table on the scorecard.

precomputed.label: Precomputed · official plan
precomputed.explanation: Computed ahead of time by the validated pipeline and listed on the scorecard.

live.label: Computed live · not part of the validated scorecard
live.explanation: Computed on request by the same engine as the official plan, but not checked against the scorecard.

hypotheticalTiming.label: hypothetical timing

preliminary.label: preliminary
preliminary.explanation: The highlight threshold is not yet confirmed by the science lead; outlines may change.

estimate.label: estimate
estimate.explanation: Instant preview with no manifest entry; compute the full plan for checked numbers.

dummy.explanation: Dummy data: synthetic world, not Mars results. Never capture.
